title: Step 3c - Polynomial Regression: Curve Fitting for Better Predictions

cues.en: Instructor: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做吧。

cues.en: Let's close the linear regression results and let's start to visualize the polynomial regression results.
cues.zh: 先關閉線性迴歸結果，開始呈現多項式迴歸結果。

cues.en: And you're gonna see now how easy it is to go from the linear regression results to the polynomial regression results.
cues.zh: 你會看到，從線性迴歸結果改成多項式迴歸結果非常簡單。

cues.en: Because what we'll simply do here is, you know select this and paste it here.
cues.zh: 因為只要選取這一段，再貼到這裡。

cues.en: And now you will see how we only need to change very few things.
cues.zh: 接著你會看到，只需要修改很少幾個地方。

cues.en: So as usual, let's start with the simplest, let's replace linear here by polynomial.
cues.zh: 和往常一樣，先從最簡單的開始，把這裡的 Linear 換成 Polynomial。

cues.en: Okay, and now what do we need to change?
cues.zh: 好，還需要修改什麼？

cues.en: Okay, so do we need to change something in the geom point function?
cues.zh: geom_point 函式裡有需要修改的內容嗎？

cues.en: No, of course because we want to keep the same real observations.
cues.zh: 當然沒有，因為要保留相同的實際觀測資料。

cues.en: So that's okay.
cues.zh: 所以這裡不需要改。

cues.en: And then do we need to change something in the geom line function?
cues.zh: 那 geom_line 函式裡需要修改嗎？

cues.en: Of course, yes.
cues.zh: 當然需要。

cues.en: Because here we're predicting the salaries of our 10 levels in our dataset according to our linear regression model.
cues.zh: 因為目前這裡，是根據線性迴歸模型，預測資料集中 10 個職位等級的薪資。

cues.en: So according to you, what do we need to change here?
cues.zh: 你覺得這裡需要修改什麼？

cues.en: Very simply, well actually we just need to change the regressor in the predict function.
cues.zh: 其實很簡單，只要更換 predict 函式裡的迴歸器。

cues.en: And instead of taking the line reg which is the linear regressor we're gonna take the polynomial regressor.
cues.zh: 不要使用線性迴歸器 lin_reg，改用多項式迴歸器。

cues.en: That's what we called poly reg.
cues.zh: 也就是我們命名為 poly_reg 的物件。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's actually all we need to do to visualize the polynomial regression results.
cues.zh: 要呈現多項式迴歸結果，實際上只需要做這些修改。

cues.en: And you'll see that in the next sections it will actually be the same.
cues.zh: 接下來幾個章節，你會發現也是一樣。

cues.en: We will only need to change the regressor to plot the new graphic results of our future regressors.
cues.zh: 只要更換迴歸器，就能畫出後續新迴歸器的圖形結果。

cues.en: So that's very nice.
cues.zh: 所以這非常方便。

cues.en: We're actually ready right now to visualize the polynomial results.
cues.zh: 現在已經可以呈現多項式迴歸結果。

cues.en: So let's do this without waiting.
cues.zh: 不用等了，直接來做。

cues.en: I'm going to select this and press command and control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 我選取這段，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here it is.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: As you can see, this is not a straight line anymore.
cues.zh: 可以看到，現在不再是直線。

cues.en: Let's zoom on the graph.
cues.zh: 將圖表放大。

cues.en: Alright, so as I just mentioned, the first reflex to have as a machine learning scientist is that this is not a linear model anymore and by the way, congratulations, you just made your very
cues.zh: 好，剛才說過，身為機器學習研究者，首先應該意識到這已不再是線性形狀的模型。順帶一提，恭喜你剛建立了

cues.en: first non-linear model.
cues.zh: 自己的第一個非線性模型。

cues.en: We're gonna see plenty of other non-linear models in this course, but this is your first one so congratulations.
cues.zh: 這門課還會看到許多其他非線性模型，不過這是你的第一個，所以恭喜。

cues.en: So as you can see, it's not a straight line, now it's a curve and we can immediately see that the curve is approaching much better all the red observation points, and especially
cues.zh: 可以看到，它不再是直線，而是一條曲線。我們馬上能看出，它更貼近所有紅色觀測資料點，尤其是

cues.en: for the CEO here, the CEO wouldn't get mad now if we negotiated with him its future salary in a new company because now the prediction is much closer
cues.zh: 這裡的執行長。現在如果和他談新公司的未來薪資，他就不會生氣，因為預測值已更接近

cues.en: to the real observation point.
cues.zh: 實際觀測資料點。

cues.en: And let's check our employee that is about to be hired and that has a 6.5 level, while 6.5 is around here.
cues.zh: 再看看即將錄用、職位等級為 6.5 的員工，6.5 大約在這裡。

cues.en: And when we project 6.5 on our polynomial regression model represented by this blue curve here we get a predicted salary here
cues.zh: 將 6.5 投影到這條藍色曲線所代表的多項式迴歸模型，就會得到這裡的預測薪資。

cues.en: I'm projecting the point on the curve back again on the salary axis.
cues.zh: 我再把曲線上的這個點，投影回薪資軸。

cues.en: And we get actually a salary that is coming much closer to the salary mentioned by this future employee which is around 160 K here.
cues.zh: 得到的薪資，的確更接近這位未來員工所說的薪資，也就是這裡大約 16 萬。

cues.en: Well, we don't get the accurate prediction yet because that's what we're gonna do in the next tutorial, but definitely this model is fitting much better the dataset.
cues.zh: 目前還沒取得精確的預測數字，那是下一堂課要做的事，但這個模型確實更能擬合資料集。

cues.en: And now just for fun, let's add a new degree to see how this model can still be much improved and almost passing by all the points very accurately as we add more degrees.
cues.zh: 現在為了看看效果，再增加一個次數。你會看到，隨著次數提高，模型還能進步，幾乎精準通過所有資料點。

cues.en: So let's check it out.
cues.zh: 來確認一下。

cues.en: Let's close this and let's add a new degree.
cues.zh: 關閉這裡，再增加一個次數。

cues.en: So very simply, what we're gonna do is add a new degree here by copying this line, paste it here and we're gonna add a new column in our dataset
cues.zh: 做法非常簡單，複製這一行、貼在這裡，新增資料集的一個欄位，

cues.en: level four, that will correspond to our original independent variable level at the power of four.
cues.zh: 名為 Level4，對應原始自變數 Level 的四次方。

cues.en: And so therefore here, we need to compute it this way by taking the fourth power of level there.
cues.zh: 因此這裡要取 Level 的四次方，像這樣計算。

cues.en: And now let's execute this line to add the level four column in our dataset.
cues.zh: 現在執行這一行，將 Level4 欄加入資料集。

cues.en: Now you can check to see that it's here, level four.
cues.zh: 可以確認它已經在這裡，Level4。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now let's reselect this to rebuild our new polynomial regression model with this fourth degree now.
cues.zh: 現在重新選取這段，以四次多項式重新建立多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: So executing new polynomial regression model created.
cues.zh: 執行後，新的多項式迴歸模型就建立了。

cues.en: And now let's have a look at the results.
cues.zh: 現在看看結果。

cues.en: So these are the previous results corresponding to a polynomial regression model with a third degree.
cues.zh: 這是先前的結果，對應三次多項式迴歸模型。

cues.en: And now let's look at what happens with a fourth degree.
cues.zh: 現在來看看四次多項式會如何。

cues.en: So I'm going to select this and execute.
cues.zh: 選取這一段並執行。

cues.en: And here are the polynomial regression results for a polynomial regression model with a fourth degree.
cues.zh: 這就是四次多項式迴歸模型的結果。

cues.en: Okay so as you can see, we can zoom on it if you want.
cues.zh: 如果願意，我們可以再放大。

cues.en: As you can see, the line is actually strictly passing by all the red observation points.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這條線幾乎準確通過所有紅色觀測資料點。

cues.en: And now the CEO would be even happier with the negotiation, or should I say even less furious?
cues.zh: 現在執行長對薪資協商應該會更開心，或者應該說，沒那麼生氣？

cues.en: Because the prediction now is actually almost the same as the real observation point.
cues.zh: 因為現在的預測值，幾乎等同於實際觀測資料點。

cues.en: That is the predicted salary is almost the same as the real salary.
cues.zh: 也就是預測薪資幾乎和實際薪資相同。

cues.en: Okay and same for our 6.5 level employee.
cues.zh: 對職位等級 6.5 的員工也一樣。

cues.en: When we project this 6.5 level here on the curve and then project it again on the Y axis that is the salary axis, we get a value around what he said that is 160 K.
cues.zh: 將 6.5 投影到曲線，再投影到 Y 軸，也就是薪資軸，就得到接近他所說的數值：16 萬。

cues.en: And for those of you who are interested in having a more continuous curve here like we did in Python, I will add the code for that job in the R file provided in this section.
cues.zh: 如果你也想像 Python 版本那樣，讓曲線更連續，我會在本節提供的 R 檔案裡加入相關程式碼。

cues.en: You can check it out for fun.
cues.zh: 有興趣可以看看。

cues.en: And this is the model we're going to use to get the accurate prediction of the previous salary of this new employee that is about to be hired.
cues.zh: 我們就要使用這個模型，精確預測這位即將錄用的新員工先前的薪資。

cues.en: And we will compare it to the salary that it pretended to have in its previous company and eventually tell our final verdict whether it's truth or bluff.
cues.zh: 再和他聲稱在上一家公司領的薪資比較，最後判定他是在說實話還是唬人。

cues.en: So I look forward to doing that with you in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 很期待在下一堂課和你一起完成。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
